description: The environment's connector registry (the same list the portal's Add a tool shows): Microsoft-published and custom connectors, with an mcpLikely flag for MCP servers. Cached under .cs-catalog/<environment>/connectors.json for offline use; with search and no sign-in, falls back to the offline seed of public connectors.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_list_connectors
title: List connectors available in an environment
